title: The Mouse Marries Only a Mouse
logline: A mouse turned into a girl asks for the strongest husband in the world; sun, cloud, wind and mountain each point to someone stronger, until the chain ends at a mouse, and she chooses to be a mouse again.
moral: Everyone returns to their own nature; real strength and the right home may be small and close to the ground.
tone: Warm, gently comic cumulative tale. Giants with funny faces, a tender father and daughter, a circular ending that should feel like coming home, not like a loss.

beats.summary: The mouse falls from the hawk and lands before the ascetic.
He prays that she become a girl so he can protect her.
POOF: mouse becomes a little girl (hair buns like mouse ears).
Years later she is grown; the marriage question.
She wants the strongest of all: the quest begins.
The cloud blots out the sun.
The wind shoves the cloud about.
The wind flattens itself on the unmoving mountain.
The strongest of all is a mouse.
The mouse declines: she is human, his home is tiny.
She asks to be a mouse again.
She waves goodbye and enters the mouse's home; the giants look down at the small lit door.

scenes.summary: The mountain wakes with a rumble and confesses: a small creature beats it. Its eyes lead us down to a tiny hole; a mouse pops out. A cutaway shows him tunnelling a home inside the rock. The mountain blocks the hole with a boulder; the mouse pops out of a new one. Daughter and father stare at each other.

camera.notes: 106.3 wide zoom 0.9 on the face. 108.0-110.3 follow the mountain's eye line: tilt down and push to zoom 2.2 on the hole at (700,885). 114.2 the round cutaway (r 230 on screen) opens upper left while the camera holds. 119.7 ease out to zoom 1.3 for the boulder gag. 122.3 push to a two-shot of the pair, zoom 2.0.

scenes.composition: Mountain face: eyes are two ledges at (520,380) and (700,380), mouth a crack at (610,520), 170 wide. Hole A at (700,885), 26 wide, 22 high. Hole B at (640,880). Pair stand at x 300/390. Cutaway centred on screen upper left, with a dotted pointer to the flank.

actions.action: Two rock ledges lift like eyelids; pebbles skitter down; a slow rumble shakes the picture
actions.acting: panel-only shake 2 px for 0.5 s; lids open over 0.6 s, heavy

actions.action: The pair jump back; she ducks behind her father, then peeks
actions.acting: sq 0.9 startle, settleTo; father's arm out to shield her

actions.action: The crack mouth opens and speaks, very slowly
actions.acting: talk 0.5 at half the usual rate; gaze down at the pair

actions.action: Its eyes roll down and to its own right foot
actions.acting: pupils travel over 0.8 s; brow worried

actions.action: Tilt down the slope along that eye line toward the foot
actions.acting: pair's heads turn to follow

actions.action: Arrow and label SMALL... point at a tiny dark hole
actions.acting: arrow three times longer than the hole is wide

actions.action: Rank strip: a fifth slot opens with only a question mark; the pair exchange a look
actions.acting: lookAt each other, brows up

actions.action: Hold: two eye glints in the dark of the hole, then whiskers and a nose
actions.acting: suspense by stillness: only the glints blink
actions.library: clip to the hole edge (head out of a hole)

actions.action: The mouse pops out, sits up and waves; the strip's last slot fills with a mouse icon wearing a tiny crown
actions.acting: hop out with landSquash, sniff, paw raise; maiden's jaw drops
actions.library: rat kind 'mouse' pal 1; hop, landSquash; rankStrip n=5

actions.action: A round cutaway opens on the flank: inside the rock the mouse digs with both front paws, grit flying
actions.acting: dig cycle 6 strokes per second, body rocks
actions.library: macroLens (planned) as cutaway; rat dig field

actions.action: The tunnel line grows through the rock in three branches like a maze
actions.acting: path draws on with K.beat; dashed white on dark rock

actions.action: At the end of one branch he hollows a round room, pushing a pebble out with his back
actions.acting: effort: tip 0.2, feet slip twice

actions.action: The room gets a tiny bed, a lamp and a mat, one pop each; label HOME
actions.acting: three pops 0.2 s apart

actions.action: The mountain squirms: eyes cross, the mouth wobbles, an eyelid twitches with every scratch
actions.acting: tickle, not pain; twitch synced to the dig cycle

actions.action: It shrugs a boulder loose; the boulder rolls down and plugs hole A
actions.acting: rolling rotation from distance travelled; lands with squash and dust at 120.5

actions.action: The mouse pops out of a brand new hole beside it, dusts his paws and shrugs; the mountain sighs a puff of dust
actions.acting: hole B appears with 4 flying chips; mountain brows droop, lids half

actions.action: Slowly she turns from the mouse to her father
actions.acting: eyes lead, head follows 3 frames later; mouth o

actions.action: Father, just as stunned, looks at her and lifts both palms
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp, brow -1

actions.action: Her hand covers her mouth; both turn to the lens for one beat; an exclamation mark pops between them
actions.acting: the film's only look to camera: gaze [0,0.05], blink suppressed 0.8 s

scenes.summary: Ground level, at mouse scale. He is sweeping his doorstep when two enormous pairs of feet arrive. Father kneels and proposes on his daughter's behalf. The mouse looks up, and up: she is human, his door is smaller than her sandal. In his thought cloud: a she-mouse his own size.

camera.notes: Low angle, zoom 2.6 centre (640,840): the mouse is 150 px tall on screen. 132.0-133.6 tilt up the maiden's full height (zoom 1.5) and back down by 134.2. From 139.7 zoom 2.2, room for the thought cloud above the mouse.

scenes.composition: Mouse at (690, 900) facing left, hole A (boulder now rolled aside) behind him at x 720. Father kneels at x 520, face at mouse-shot height. Maiden stands at x 420; at zoom 2.6 only her hem and feet show until the tilt. Thought cloud at (760,700) world, 220 wide.

actions.action: At his doorstep the mouse sweeps with a twig broom, humming
actions.acting: broom strokes every 0.4 s, eyes down, tail sways

actions.action: Two pairs of huge feet walk into frame from the left; a finger points down at him
actions.acting: footfalls make the mouse hop 3 px each (kick); PERSON_HANDS.pointDown

actions.action: A shadow covers him; he looks up, and up, until he tips over backwards onto his tail
actions.acting: gaze up, head back, tip -0.3, small bounce (rebound)

actions.action: Father kneels down to mouse level, hand on his chest, polite
actions.acting: kneel 0 to 1 with settle; warm smile; mouse scrambles upright and straightens his whiskers

actions.action: Speaks, his open hand sweeping back toward his daughter
actions.acting: talk 0.7, handL reach behind

actions.action: A speech balloon from the father: two rings and a question mark
actions.acting: balloon placed left of his head, never over a face

actions.action: Tilt from the mouse all the way up the maiden to her face; she gives a small shy wave down; a double-headed arrow measures her against him
actions.acting: the tilt takes a full second: the height is the joke; label A BIT TALL

actions.action: Back on the mouse: the broom drops from his paws
actions.acting: eyes wide, ears up, broom fallY and one bounce

actions.action: He answers kindly, both paws up, palms out
actions.acting: talk 0.8, ears half back, brow -0.5 apologetic

actions.action: Measures himself with a flat paw on his head, then points up at her
actions.acting: looks from paw to her face

actions.action: Arrow and label HUMAN point up at the maiden; she looks down at herself
actions.acting: her gaze drops to her own hands

actions.action: Sweeps a paw to his front door; arrow and label MY HOME
actions.acting: proud little bow

actions.action: She sets her sandal beside the door: the sandal alone is three times as wide
actions.acting: careful, on tiptoe; mouse hops aside

actions.action: She crouches and pokes one fingertip into the hole; a quick cutaway shows the finger knocking over the tiny bed; the mouse covers his eyes
actions.acting: cutaway flashes 0.8 s; she winces, mouths sorry

actions.action: He stands tall on his hind legs, paw on his heart
actions.acting: stand 1, sincere eyes (lid 0.15)

actions.action: Thought cloud over him: a she-mouse his own size standing beside him, a heart between them; label A MOUSE LIKE ME
actions.acting: pops on the word; the maiden's eyes lock on the she-mouse

actions.action: He shakes his head gently
actions.acting: three small head turns, eyes closed

actions.action: In the cloud a giant human foot replaces the she-mouse, with a red cross box; watching, the maiden's nose twitches and her hand rises to one hair bun
actions.acting: the idea lands on her face before she says anything: brows lift, slow blink

scenes.summary: She sees her own shadow on the rock: with the hair buns it is a mouse's shadow. She smiles, takes her father's hands and asks to be a mouse again and marry this mouse. Father's eyes fill; he nods, hugs her, prays. POOF: a small she-mouse sits in the fallen yellow scarf.

camera.notes: 144.2 medium zoom 1.5 including her shadow on the rock wall. 146.8 two-shot of daughter and father, zoom 2.0 (twoShot margin 70). 155.3 ease out to zoom 1.5 for the light cone and burst. 157.4 push to zoom 2.4 on the scarf.

scenes.composition: Maiden at x 430, father at x 540 facing her, mouse at x 690. Her shadow falls right and up onto the rock at (560,640). Burst centre (430,860). Scarf lands at (430,900).

actions.action: In the pause the low sun throws her shadow on the rock: head and two buns, the outline of a mouse; she notices it
actions.acting: shadow fades in 0.4 s; she turns her head to it; its 'ears' move with her buns

actions.action: A slow smile spreads; her shoulders drop
actions.acting: mouth closed to smile over 0.6 s, lid 0.2, breathe

actions.action: The mouse watches her smile and tilts his head, puzzled
actions.acting: ears uneven, one paw raised

actions.action: She turns to her father and takes both his hands
actions.acting: hand IK meeting his; eye contact

actions.action: Close two-shot; he searches her face
actions.acting: brow -0.5, gaze flicks between her eyes (saccades)

actions.action: She speaks softly
actions.acting: talk 0.6, small nods

actions.action: Thought cloud between them: the tiny mouse on his cupped palms from the riverbank
actions.acting: same drawing as 13.4 s so the memory is exact

actions.action: His eyes shine; he looks down at his own open palm
actions.acting: wet true, slow blink, mouth trembles into a smile

actions.action: She points down at the mouse
actions.acting: arm by angle, smile, glance down

actions.action: He points at himself: ears shoot up, cheeks dot red, his tail curls into a heart
actions.acting: stretch sq 1.12, then tremble of delight

actions.action: A long blink, a breath, one tear wiped with his sleeve; then a firm, smiling nod
actions.acting: grief to resolve, kept light: lid 1 for 0.4 s, breathe, nod drop 8 px

actions.action: A last hug at human size; he steps back and lifts both hands as he did by the river; the cone of light returns
actions.acting: mirror of 16.3-18.3; eyes closed

actions.action: POOF: the same star burst; her silhouette shrinks straight down inside it
actions.acting: burst identical to 23.2; silhouette sq 1 to 0.25; the yellow scarf floats down after her
actions.library: poofTransform reverse; fallY slow for the scarf

actions.action: The puff clears: a small she-mouse sits in the middle of the fallen scarf, a tiny yellow bow between her ears; she looks at her paws and twitches her nose
actions.acting: the same blink-and-look-at-hands business as the child at 25.3

actions.action: He offers a shy paw; she scampers off the cloth and they touch noses; a small heart
actions.acting: his ears flat with shyness, her tail up

scenes.summary: He bows her in first. On the threshold she turns and waves to her father; he waves back with wet eyes. A warm light comes on in the hole. Father folds the scarf and heads home as the camera rises: sun, cloud, wind and mountain all look down at the tiny lit door. THE END.

camera.notes: 159.2 zoom 2.4 at the door. 160.3 widen to 1.8 to hold father and door together. 162.3-164.6 slow pull out and crane up to zoom 0.82, whole mountain and sky. Hold for THE END.

scenes.composition: Door at (700,885). Father kneeling at x 540, then walking left and out at x 150 by 167. Final wide: sun upper right (840,170), cloud (300,220), wind curl (140,420), mountain face centre; the lit hole is the brightest warm point, bottom right. THE END centred at y 520, clear of all faces.

actions.action: The two mice trot to the door; he bows and sweeps a paw: after you
actions.acting: scurry by distance; bow tip 0.3

actions.action: On the threshold she stops, turns, stands up and waves at her father
actions.acting: turn with a squeeze (turnFlip), stand 1, paw wave 3 beats

actions.action: Kneeling, he waves back with two fingers; eyes wet, smiling
actions.acting: wet true, small wave, slow blink

actions.action: She slips inside, he follows; her tail tip flicks last; a warm yellow light comes on in the hole
actions.acting: light = yellow disc with a dotted glow r 40
actions.library: clip at the hole edge; glow

actions.action: He picks up the yellow scarf, folds it once and holds it to his chest, then stands
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.chest holding the cloth; breathe

actions.action: Slow pull out and crane up; father turns and walks home to the left with his stick
actions.acting: walk amp 0.7, one look back over the shoulder at 163.4

actions.action: The whole sky cast is in frame, each looking down at the little light; the rank strip completes: sun, cloud, wind, mountain, mouse, and a heart replaces the crown
actions.acting: sun, cloud and wind gaze lookAt(hole); they blink out of unison

actions.action: The mountain smiles and closes its eyes over its new neighbours
actions.acting: lids ease shut, mouth crack curves up

actions.action: THE END, held 3 s; the window light flickers gently, the cloud drifts, father is a small figure leaving frame left
actions.acting: nothing covers a face; idle life only

ending.description: Final wide held from 165.0 to 168.0: the whole mountain with closed, smiling eyes; sun, cloud and wind looking down; the tiny mouse door glowing warm at bottom right; the father a small figure walking home left. THE END in Bangers at centre, clear of all faces. The rank strip stays complete with a heart over the mouse.

subtitles.ar: كان ناسك يجلس قرب نهر، فرأى طائرًا يحمل فأرة صغيرة في مخالبه.|سقطت الفأرة من الطائر أمامه، فحملها برفق.|أراد أن يحميها، فدعا الله أن تصبح فتاة تستطيع العيش في بيته.
subtitles.en: An ascetic was sitting beside a river when he saw a bird carrying a little mouse in its claws.|The mouse fell in front of him, and he picked her up gently.|Wanting to protect her, he prayed that she might become a girl and live in his home.

subtitles.ar: تحولت الفأرة إلى طفلة جميلة، وأخذها الناسك إلى زوجته.|ربياها كأنها ابنتهما، ومرت سنوات كثيرة حتى صارت شابة.|وفي يوم، سألها أبوها عن الرجل الذي تريد الزواج منه.
subtitles.en: The mouse turned into a beautiful little girl, and the ascetic took her to his wife.|They raised her as their own daughter. Many years passed, and she grew into a young woman.|One day, her father asked whom she wanted to marry.

subtitles.ar: قالت الفتاة: «أريد زوجًا أقوى من الجميع.»|فكر الأب قليلًا، ثم قال: «إذن اسألي الشمس.|إنها تضيء العالم كله، ولا نعرف شيئًا أقوى منها.»|فذهبا إلى الشمس.
subtitles.en: “I want a husband stronger than everyone,” the young woman said.|Her father thought for a moment. “Then ask the sun,” he said.|“It lights the whole world, and we know nothing stronger.”|So they went to the sun.

subtitles.ar: لكن الشمس قالت: «السحاب أقوى مني، لأنه يستطيع أن يحجب نوري.»|ذهبا إلى السحاب، فقال: «الريح أقوى مني.|إنها تدفعني من مكان إلى آخر، ولا أستطيع مقاومتها.»
subtitles.en: But the sun said, “The cloud is stronger than I am, because it can block my light.”|They went to the cloud, which said, “The wind is stronger than I am.|It pushes me from one place to another, and I cannot resist it.”

subtitles.ar: سألا الريح، فقالت: «الجبل أقوى مني.|أستطيع تحريك السحاب والأشجار، لكن الجبل يبقى ثابتًا مهما هببت.»|فرحت الفتاة، وذهبت مع أبيها إلى الجبل الكبير.
subtitles.en: They asked the wind, which said, “The mountain is stronger than I am.|I can move clouds and trees, but the mountain stays in place however hard I blow.”|The young woman was pleased, and she and her father went to the great mountain.

subtitles.ar: قال الجبل: «هناك مخلوق صغير أقوى مني.|إنه الفأر الذي يحفر داخل الصخور، ويصنع لنفسه بيتًا في جسمي.|لا أقدر على منعه.»|نظرت الفتاة إلى أبيها بدهشة.
subtitles.en: The mountain said, “There is a little creature stronger than I am: the mouse.|He digs into the rocks and makes a home inside me.|I cannot stop him.”|The young woman looked at her father in surprise.

subtitles.ar: وجدا فأرًا قرب الجبل،|وسأله الناسك: «هل تتزوج ابنتي؟»|قال الفأر: «لكنها إنسانة، وبيتي صغير جدًا.|أستطيع الزواج من فأرة مثلي، لا من إنسانة.»
subtitles.en: They found a mouse near the mountain,|and the ascetic asked, “Will you marry my daughter?”|The mouse replied, “But she is human, and my home is very small.|I can marry a mouse like myself, not a human.”

subtitles.ar: ابتسمت الفتاة وقالت لأبيها:|«أريد أن أعود فأرة كما كنت، وأتزوج هذا الفأر.»|وافق الأب، فتحولت إلى فأرة من جديد.|دخلت بيت الفأر، وانتهت رحلتها الطويلة عند الجبل.
subtitles.en: The young woman smiled and told her father,|“I want to become a mouse again, as I once was, and marry this mouse.”|Her father agreed, and she turned back into a mouse.|She entered the mouse’s home, and her long journey ended beside the mountain.

new_assets.name: rat
new_assets.description: Reuse the planned rat figure (KD-011) and add kind 'mouse': 70 % size, rounder ears (r 16 at s 1), two palettes (0 light grey, 1 brown-grey with head tuft). Extra fields: held (curled, limp legs for carrying), stand 0..1 (on hind legs), raise (front paw), dig (paw cycle), bow (yellow bow), noseTwitch, plus the shared acting fields.
new_assets.implementation: Body = two ellipses and a round head, ears as circles, tail as a K bezier stroke driven by swing(); legs phase from walk(). About 60 units long at s 1; in S12 draw at s 1 with camera zoom 2.6 rather than scaling the figure.

new_assets.name: hawk (bird kind)
new_assets.description: Reuse the planned hawk kind on the Library bird, with talons that grip and the planned bird 'carry' callback so the mouse hangs from the feet.
new_assets.implementation: Palette and hooked beak on bird(); carry draws mouseHer at the talon point with swing().

new_assets.name: person costume presets (ascetic, maiden)
new_assets.description: Two more presets for the planned person costume layer: 'ascetic' (off-white robe, small turban, beard grey or white by age 0..1, bare feet) and 'maiden' (yellow dress, yellow headscarf, two hair buns r 13 at head top, optional noseTwitch). The child uses the planned person child option in the maiden palette; the wife uses the planned villager villageWoman.
new_assets.implementation: Parameter objects over person(): headwear, beard, palette, age; buns are two circles drawn before the head.

new_assets.name: person kneel / sit
new_assets.description: Reuse the planned kneel 0..1 and sit 0..1: the ascetic sits cross-legged, kneels to the mouse; father and daughter sit on the bench.
new_assets.implementation: As planned by AN-095/KD-009: lower the hip, fold the leg shapes, keep arm IK.

new_assets.name: elementFace
new_assets.description: One face rig for things that are not animals: two eyes (with per-eye lids lidL/lidR, gaze, brow), a mouth (closed, smile, frown, o, talk) and a width parameter. Used on the sun (150 wide), cloud (130), wind curl (70) and mountain (ledges as lids, crack as mouth).
new_assets.implementation: A function elementFace(ctx, {x, y, w, gaze, lidL, lidR, brow, mouth, talk, style:'ink'|'rock'}) using the same eye2 helper as the cast so gaze and blink() behave identically.

new_assets.name: windSpirit
new_assets.description: The wind as five tapering brush bands following one bezier path, with elementFace in the leading curl; states idle, coil (anticipation), blow (bands straighten, speed lines), flat (pancake on impact), limp.
new_assets.implementation: Each band is a stroked K bezier offset along the path normal, phase-shifted by sin(t); position from a keyed path so every frame is a function of t. White with pale-blue second pass and black brush outline.

new_assets.name: mountain
new_assets.description: Grey triangular massif with snow cap, three ridge lines, pebbles, optional face (elementFace style 'rock'), mouse holes at given points, a boulder, and a far version at 40 % scale. Optional round cutaway interior with tunnel polyline, room, bed, lamp, mat.
new_assets.implementation: Polygon in den() greys with Ben-Day shade on the right flank, baked once with bake(); face, holes, boulder and cutaway drawn live on top. Cutaway = the planned macroLens circle with a dark rock fill.

new_assets.name: poofTransform
new_assets.description: Transformation burst: stars spiral in (gather), star burst plus puff ring with a 2-frame flash, two black silhouettes cross-scaled inside (from, to), puff clears. Runs forward (mouse to girl) and reversed (woman to mouse).
new_assets.implementation: S.emphasis burst, 8 seeded stars on a spiral, cloud puffs from cloudFlat circles; silhouettes via the cast function drawn in solid black.

new_assets.name: rankStrip
new_assets.description: Five-slot chain of 56 px icons (sun, cloud, wind, mountain, mouse) with small arrows, a hopping STRONGEST? tag, a crown and finally a heart; drawn in panel space at the top of the picture, hidden during S1-S5, S12 and close shots where it would crowd a face.
new_assets.implementation: S.box per slot with simplified flat icons; n and tag position keyed by time with settleTo pops.

new_assets.name: skyLight
new_assets.description: Soft cone of yellow halftone light from the top of the frame for the two prayers.
new_assets.implementation: Clipped trapezoid with a vertical alpha ramp and Ben-Day dots.

new_assets.name: thoughtCloud
new_assets.description: Reuse the planned generic thought cloud for the wish (18.0), the groom (42.2), the mouse's ideal wife (141.2) and the memory (150.0).

owner_questions: The fall is softened: the mouse bounces through the fig tree's leaves before landing unhurt (default: yes).
Prayer is shown only as raised hands, closed eyes and a cone of light from above, with no figure in the sky (default: yes).
Sun, cloud, wind and mountain get simple cartoon faces and act (the script lets them speak); default: yes.
The girl keeps two round hair buns and a nose twitch as a visual echo of the mouse, and her shadow looks like a mouse at 144.5 s (default: yes).

Added comic business not in the script: mother eavesdropping at the window, the wind flattening on the mountain, the boulder and second hole, the finger knocking over the mouse's bed (default: keep all).
An on-screen rank strip of icons (sun, cloud, wind, mountain, mouse) tracks who is stronger (default: yes).

Invented lettering: PLOP!, POOF! (twice), THE STRONGEST!, BLOCKED!, WHOOSH!, BONK! (twice), THAT ONE!, SQUEAK!, DIG DIG DIG, POP!, ME?!, and labels such as YEARS LATER..., ALL GROWN UP, A MOUSE LIKE ME (default: keep).
The mother does not travel and is not in the ending; the father walks home alone carrying the folded scarf, smiling (default: yes, bittersweet but warm).
implementation_notes: Timing: use w(p, n) from timing.json; every cue.t here is the word start in planning/inputs/timeline.md. Word starts can include up to 0.4 s of silence, so check the POOFs (23.20, 156.32), the shoves (80.70, 82.66) and the BONK (98.04) against the audio by ear.

Only seven sound effects, all in listed pauses or after the last word: 3.2 whoosh, 22.6 chime, 50.95 pop, 63.2 pop, 65.9 chime, 144.6 chime, 165.3 chime. The POOF at 156.32 is silent on purpose (no pause there).

Scale plan: people s 0.6 in the sky scenes and s 0.95 in the yard; mice are drawn at s 1 (about 60 units long) and read through camera zoom 2.2-2.6 in S12-S14. Check the mouse is at least 110 px on screen whenever it acts.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame; elementFace must also take blink() seeds so the giants blink, never in unison.
The dimming at 72.92 is an overlay inside the picture panel clip only; restore it when the cloud leaves (82.66 briefly, fully at 85.0).
The hair buns must be visible in every maiden and child pose; they carry the shadow gag at 144.5 and the ending.
The camera cut from early to later yard hides under the YEARS LATER... card (two camera keys 0.01 s apart at 35.9).
rankStrip is drawn after the world and before finish; hide it whenever a face or label would come within 40 px of it.
Subtitles: use the | marks in 'subtitles' for chunks_ar.txt and chunks_en.txt; P6 chunk 1 ends at different points in the two languages by design (English names the mouse earlier).
Call finish last; apply shakes inside the panel clip only; no en or em dashes in any lettering.
warnings: Four speaking non-animal characters need one new shared rig (elementFace); budget it first because sun, cloud, wind and mountain all depend on it.

The planned assets rat, hawk, villageYard, person kneel/sit, child option, costume presets, thoughtCloud and macroLens do not exist in Library yet; if this story is built before KD-009/KD-010/KD-011, they must be drawn here under the same names.
Scale contrast (mountain, people, mice) is the main legibility risk on a phone; the S12 low-angle shot and the final wide must be checked on a contact sheet.
S11 is 20.4 s with about 20 actions including the cutaway; if it feels crowded drop the boulder gag (119.70-122.2) first.
The S1 fall lasts 2.8 s of narration; the leaf bounce fills it. If the Library river set cannot lose islandHut cleanly, cover the right bank with bush().
